about_the_game:
Death spared you, but it’s not done with you yet. In Discarding Death, a work-in-progress indie card game, you play a standard 52-card deck—plus four Jokers—against Death itself to keep your Health, Mental, Soul, and Funds above zero. Each round, draw five cards, compare with Death’s play, and choose from three options shown as clean stat and card icons. Your choices shift your stats, balancing survival with strategy in a retro pixel-art world.

Delay tough plays with the Procrastination Window, but timers mean penalties if you wait too long. Seasons change how suits like Hearts or Clubs score, keeping your tactics fresh. Jokers trigger special events with bold rewards or risks, adding depth to each day’s battles. With minimalist pixel visuals and lofi beats, this single-player card game blends casual play with strategic management. A solo dev’s vision, Discarding Death will evolve with new features. Can you outlast Death?
